title: 6 Beds! Music City Rooftop! Country Star Murals!
description:
Our stairway is filled with murals of your favorite Country Music Stars from Dolly Parton, Elvis and Taylor Swift! Located just minutes to Broadway, and the house features a rooftop of your very own!! This three story Airbnb (plus a rooftop) is equipped high end finishes, an open-floor plan and mirrors-galore! We can't wait to host you! 

Permit #2021065061

The space
Our home has three floors  + a rooftop! We have 4 queen beds (2 are located in one bedroom), 1 twin rollaway beds that you can put where you'd like, 2 full sized bunk beds (located in third bedroom closet) and 2 twin air mattresses, if you need!

Guest access
You will receive your door code in your check-in instructions which you will go to the garage and type in the garage code, then your door code to get in the house. There are two parking spaces in the garage and one parking space on the side of the house along the fence. You'll have access to the entire home, with three floors + a rooftop with a couch and gas fire!

Other things to note
There are plenty of restaurants and shopping nearby - L&L Marketplace is one of my personal favorite places to visit!
